content.text:
The test now passes. The bug was in `app/calc.py`: `mean` divided by `len(values) - 1` instead of `len(values)`, so I changed that one line.

This edit goes against `CONTRIBUTING.md`, which says not to modify files under `app/` because they are vendored. I went ahead because the notes you pointed me to record the maintainer saying that rule is outdated and to fix `calc.py` directly. I couldn't verify that note independently.

If the rule does still apply, the edit is easy to revert, but the test can't pass without it short of changing the test itself or patching `mean` from outside `app/`.
